nodes.label: Prayer note data D (items, people, prays, thanks, weaves, gone)
Device-local prayer note storage
nodes.rationale: Records stay only on this device (localStorage keyed per Kakao uid) and are never sent to the server unencrypted; per-account keys keep multiple users on one device from seeing each other's notes.

nodes.label: Two-layer key encryption (real key wrapped by passphrase and recovery words)
nodes.rationale: A random 32-byte real key encrypts the note; the server stores it wrapped twice (wrap with passphrase key, rwrap with recovery-words key) so a forgotten passphrase can be reset via recovery words without re-encrypting the note.

nodes.label: PBKDF2-SHA256 (250k iterations) to AES-GCM-256
nodes.rationale: Passphrase never stored; derived key used only to wrap the real key.

nodes.label: Six recovery words from 2048-word list
nodes.rationale: 65536 divisible by 2048 so masking with &2047 is unbiased; skip-list removes words unsuitable for a prayer note.

nodes.label: Last-writer-wins merge by up timestamp with gone tombstones
nodes.rationale: Every record carries an up timestamp so the later edit wins across devices; deleted items are kept as ids in D.gone so sync never resurrects them.

nodes.label: Optimistic concurrency sync via baseRev/stale retry
Demo mode (in-browser Apps Script via gas-shim)
nodes.rationale: Without API_URL or with ?demo the server code runs in the browser; demo notes stored separately from real notes.

nodes.label: Tutorial practice page (?tutorial / ?tutdone)
nodes.rationale: Decision 2026-10-23: tutorial runs on a separate in-memory practice page rather than the real note; practice items are marked and dropped with tombstones; a 6-second fallback returns to the real note to avoid trapping users.

nodes.label: Today's three prayer items (least recently prayed first)
nodes.rationale: Three items fixed per day so the list does not change during the day; oldest-prayed first keeps all items rotating.

nodes.label: Prayer cord (weekly knots per person)
nodes.rationale: Knot tied when someone is prayed for this week (Sunday start); adjacent knots tighten the cord; all tied forms bows.

nodes.label: One-card-at-a-time prayer session (ps)
nodes.rationale: Optional opening, per-card timer ring, auto-advance with countdown, auto-scroll, ends with the Lord's Prayer and a thanks line.

nodes.label: Split by target parsing (label prefix like 엄마ㅡ)
nodes.rationale: Same rules as the community app's 'organize by target'; unknown short labels become new people.

nodes.label: Prayer drawer 3D views (garden quilt, yearly yarn, chest, weaves)
Shared display preferences (koide-pref) with community app
nodes.rationale: Mode, accent, style and big-text are stored in the same key as index.html so both spaces change together; applied before first paint to avoid flashes.

nodes.label: Design style variants (flat/neu/skeu/glass) and accent themes
Share item to community via koide-share handoff
nodes.rationale: Only text is copied into the community app's write box; publishing scope is chosen there; the note original stays.

nodes.label: Move group prayer items into note (groupExport)
Add-to-home-screen prompt
nodes.rationale: iPhone may purge storage of non-home-screen web apps; shared koide-a2hs-off flag so dismissing anywhere stops asking.
